description:
Reclaim your photo library — and keep it effortlessly organized.

[Special Offer for New Users] Get 100 free photo deletions! Enjoy fast, thorough photo decluttering with no subscription required.

Powered by on-device AI, 图豆 (Photato) intelligently cleans up unwanted photos to free up storage space in an instant. All analysis happens entirely on your device. Nothing is uploaded, nothing is shared.

---

AI Smart Organizing · One-Tap Cleanup
• AI similar photo recommendations — shots from the same scene or burst are automatically detected and grouped. No more hunting manually.
• AI best photo picking — smartly recommends the sharpest shot in each group, so you keep the highlights and clear the rest.
• Duplicate detection — find and remove identical photos that are wasting space.
• Smart grouping by time — similar and duplicate photos are automatically organized by capture date, month by month.
• AI junk photo detection — automatically flags blurry, closed-eye, and low-quality shots for batch cleanup.
• Screenshot cleanup · large file scanner — every kind of space killer, ready for batch deletion.
• Pending list — suggested photos are gathered in one place and only deleted after you confirm. No accidental deletes.

Fast Browsing & Management
• Swipe through your entire library fullscreen — left for older, right for newer; swipe up to move any photo to trash.
• Batch select and delete with one tap, and restore accidentally deleted photos from the built-in trash.
• Choose your preferred grid layout — 2, 3, or 4 columns.
• For You filters — quickly locate screenshots, videos, and your favorites.

Organized by Time & Albums
• Browse photos by year and month, and jump to any point in your timeline instantly.
• View and manage all your albums in one place, with smart recommendations in every album.
• "More Like This" on any photo — instantly discover other shots from the same scene.

---

Private by Design
• All photo analysis runs on-device, powered by Apple's Vision framework — no server, no cloud, no uploads.
• Zero data collection. No analytics, no ads, no tracking.
• Full photo library access is the only permission required.

---

Subscription Options
Start with a 7-day free trial. After that, choose a plan that works for you:
• Monthly subscription
• Yearly subscription (save 64%)
• Lifetime one-time purchase

Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel your subscriptions in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions.
Subscriptions are subject to Apple’s Standard Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/
whatsNew:
【What's New in 1.6.2】
- Smarter Blurry Detection: Integrated a two-stage Vision aesthetics pipeline to accurately recognize intentional portrait depth-of-field, preventing false positives
- Smoother Similar Recommendations: Similar photo results now append smoothly without replacing or jumping on the initial screen
- Create & Manage Albums: Added a dedicated "My Albums" section with quick album creation to easily organize your photos
- Full Dark Mode Support: Refined dark appearance and high contrast throughout the app for comfortable low-light viewing
- Details & Stability: Unified terminology, added in-app Feedback in Settings, enhanced VoiceOver accessibility, and fixed minor bugs
